english.note: Use this all-purpose spoken phrasing when saying what people ordinarily call something rather than its official name.

examples.english: People colloquially call this place Tai Hang, but fewer people know its official name.
examples.traditional: 呢個地方平時叫做大坑，正式名就冇咁多人識。
